verdict.rationale: Publishing fees for agent-originated transactions is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack states a fee, rate, or commission for agentic or AI-chat transactions. The pricing-page items only market selling 'in AI chats' and checkout conversion, without disclosing any agentic-channel fees.

support.subject: As a merchant, the fees for agent-originated transactions are published — I can price agentic channels without asking sales
